subject: Report builder freezing on save
body: Report Builder locks up every time I try to save changes to our weekly ops report. Had to restart the browser three times this morning.

subject: Re: report builder freezing - lost my changes twice
body: Update: lost an hour of formatting work to the freeze, twice. If this isn't fixed by end of day I'm going to have to redo the whole report by hand.

subject: Dashboard not reflecting yesterday's fix
body: Report Builder's working again, thanks, but now the ops dashboard is stuck showing last Tuesday's numbers. Feels like whack-a-mole this week.

subject: Re: dashboard stuck - fixed, appreciate the quick turnaround
body: Numbers are current again. Rough week but the team got onto each one fast - noted and appreciated.

subject: API integration broken since this morning
body: Our nightly integration job has been failing since this morning with an authentication error, no changes on our side. Need this looked at today, we report to the board tomorrow.

subject: Re: API issue - dashboards now showing blanks too
body: On top of yesterday's API failure, half our dashboard widgets are just blank this morning. Board meeting is in six hours.

subject: Alert didn't warn us about any of this
body: Given the last two days, would've been useful if our failure alerts had actually triggered. What's the point of having them configured if they stay silent through an outage like that?

subject: Report builder error code 500 on save
body: Trying to rebuild the report that broke last week and now getting a straight 500 error on save. Please just tell me if this module is stable today or not.

subject: Re: 500 error - working now, lost the will to trust it
body: It's saving again. Third module issue in two weeks though - connectors, dashboards, now this. Getting hard to plan around.

subject: Export stuck processing for over an hour
body: Export job has been stuck at 'processing' for over an hour on a report that normally takes two minutes. Need the file before close of business.

subject: API timeout on the same job as before
body: Same nightly job that broke back in September is timing out again. Please tell me this isn't going to be a recurring thing every quarter.

subject: Export missing rows again
body: Export came through with roughly a third of the rows missing, no error shown. This is becoming a pattern with this particular report.

subject: Re: missing export rows - and now a seat got deactivated
body: While waiting on the export fix, noticed one of our analyst seats got deactivated with no notice. Fix both today please, we've had enough surprises for one week.

subject: Connector failed on New Year's Day
body: First day back from holiday and the overnight connector sync failed. Nice way to start the year.

subject: Re: connector fix - dashboards not updating
body: Connector's apparently fixed but dashboards still showing stale data from before the holidays. Second day running into this.

subject: Can't add a seat for returning contractor
body: Trying to reactivate a contractor's seat from before the break and the system won't let me - says the seat is already assigned though the person's account shows inactive.

subject: Re: seat issue - now a dashboard is missing entirely
body: Fourth issue this week - one of our core dashboards has vanished from the list. Feels like a rough patch after the holidays across the board.

subject: Report builder won't let me delete an old draft
body: Trying to clean up old drafts in Report Builder and one won't delete - just spins and throws an error. Small thing but annoying.

subject: Re: draft won't delete - now can't create new ones either
body: The stuck draft from yesterday is now blocking me from creating any new reports in that folder. Getting in the way of actual work.

subject: Re: report builder folder issue - resolved, thanks
body: Folder's unstuck and I can create reports again. Appreciate the fast fix, three days in a row is a lot though.

subject: Alert configuration reset itself
body: The alert thresholds I set up last month have reverted to defaults with no notification. Third module issue this month.

subject: Connector auth failing again, same as January
body: Same connector authentication failure we had back in January is back. Would be good to understand what's actually causing this rather than just resetting it each time.

subject: Re: connector issue - export now failing silently
body: Connector's back up but the scheduled export tied to it just silently didn't run overnight. No error, no file.

subject: API calls failing intermittently, third day in a row
body: API's throwing intermittent errors, third day of issues this week. Starting to feel like everything touches the same underlying problem.

subject: Re: this week - report builder now too
body: Adding report builder to the list of things broken this week. Formulas referencing the API data are returning blanks.

subject: Re: formula issue - fixed, rough week all round
body: Formulas are pulling correctly again. That's the whole list cleared for this week - appreciate everyone jumping on it fast even if it was a lot.

subject: Dashboard widget error after this morning's update
body: One widget on the main dashboard is showing a red error icon since this morning's platform update. Rest looks fine.

subject: Re: dashboard error - report builder also acting up
body: Same morning, Report Builder is now also throwing errors on save. Feels connected to whatever changed today.

subject: Re: this week's issues - admin console slow to load too
body: Admin console is crawling today, on top of yesterday's dashboard and report builder problems. Please look at whatever shipped this week.

subject: Re: connectors joining the list now
body: Connector sync just failed too. That's four modules in two days - can someone confirm what changed and whether it's actually fixed everywhere, not just patched one at a time?

subject: Re: everything this week - dashboards stable again?
body: Things look stable again as of this afternoon. Would still like a straight answer on what caused four separate module issues in 48 hours, but appreciate it's sorted for now.

subject: Export file naming convention
body: Could the scheduled export file names include the date in the filename itself? Currently they overwrite the same name each week and we have to rename manually to keep a history.

subject: API usage seems lower than expected this quarter
body: Noticed our API call volume dropped off compared to last quarter, wanted to check if something changed on your end or if it's just seasonal on ours before we dig further.

subject: Turning off alerts for a decommissioned report
body: We've retired one of our older reports and would like to remove the alert tied to it rather than have it keep checking a report nobody uses anymore.

subject: Removing an old dashboard from the shared list
body: Similar to the alert we asked about a couple of weeks back - can you help us archive an old dashboard so it stops showing in the shared list for the whole team?

subject: API broke after this week's release
body: Something in this week's release broke our API integration - getting 403s on endpoints that worked fine Monday. Need this looked at, it's blocking our month-end reporting.

subject: Report builder - saved template missing after login
body: Logged in this morning and one of our saved report templates has just disappeared. Hoping this isn't going to turn into another back-and-forth like the API thing in December.

subject: Connector also broken today, on top of the missing template
body: Same day as the missing template, the connector to our CRM has also stopped syncing. Two things at once is not a great morning.

subject: Re: connector - fixed then broke again
body: Connector was working again for a day and has now dropped once more. Second time in a week.

subject: Re: connector, third time
body: Third connector failure this week. At this point I'd like someone to actually explain what's wrong rather than just restarting it each time.

subject: Re: connector - stable today, but count is now four
body: It's holding today. That's four separate connector incidents in a week though - appreciate the fast turnarounds, but the underlying issue clearly hasn't been found yet.

subject: API 403s again, same as December
body: Getting the same 403 errors on the API we saw back in December. Would like to know if it's actually the same root cause this time.

subject: Export job hanging indefinitely
body: An export job has been sitting at 0% for forty minutes on a report that usually takes under a minute. Need the file for an external meeting this afternoon.

subject: API down again, three days after the export issue
body: API's throwing errors again, three days after last week's export problem. Feels like we're getting a different module each week lately.

subject: Re: API issue - report builder also down
body: Same day as the API errors, Report Builder is now refusing to save as well. Two modules down in one afternoon.

subject: Export corrupting again
body: Export file came through corrupted, won't open in Excel. Same symptom as earlier in the year, different report this time.

subject: Re: export issue - API also acting up today
body: On the same day as the export problem, API calls are timing out too. Would like to know if these are actually connected.

subject: Connector down again after months of being fine
body: First connector issue in a while, but it's back - sync failed overnight, same connector as the string of failures back in the spring.

subject: Report builder crashing on our year-end template
body: Report Builder crashes every time we open the year-end template specifically - other reports open fine. Need this working before Friday's close.

subject: Re: year-end template - connector also failing today
body: Same day as the report builder crash, the connector feeding that exact report has also stopped syncing. Bad timing given the close.

subject: Connector sync failing every few days
body: This is the third time this month our main ERP connector has dropped sync overnight. Fixed each time but it's eating into our morning.

subject: Dashboard load times still an issue
body: Dashboards are taking noticeably longer to load again, similar to the sync problems earlier in the year. Nothing's changed on our side.

subject: Seat provisioning delayed a week now
body: Requested two new seats over a week ago and they still haven't gone live. We have new starters sitting without access.

subject: Report builder down for the second week running
body: Report Builder has now been unusable for parts of two separate weeks. Between this and the seat delay, it's been one thing after another since October.

subject: Alert issue still open after weeks
body: Following up on the alert configuration problem - it's been open for a while now with no real update. At this rate I'm not sure what we're paying the support tier for.

subject: Report builder broken again, over the holidays no less
body: Report Builder is down again, this time over the holiday period when half our team is trying to close out the year. This has been a rough few months across the board.

subject: Escalating - connector issues have not stopped since summer
body: I need to escalate this properly. Since the summer we've had recurring connector failures, delayed seat provisioning, report builder outages, and an alert ticket that sat open for a month. Individually each gets fixed, but the pattern hasn't. I'd like a call with someone senior about what's actually going on.

subject: Re: escalation - report builder again while we wait for the call
body: Still waiting to hear back on scheduling that call, and in the meantime Report Builder has gone down again. Would appreciate someone actually owning this.

subject: Re: escalation - seats now too
body: Adding to the escalation - seat provisioning is delayed again, same issue as last November. I raised this months ago and I'm still chasing the same categories of problem.

subject: Following up after the escalation call
body: Wanted to say the changes since our call have made a real difference - this API issue came up but got resolved same-day, which is a different world from where things were in the spring.

subject: Export question, low priority
body: Minor one - an export came through with a slightly different column order than usual. Not urgent, just flagging in case it's a symptom of something.

subject: Another quick API question
body: Following up quickly - is there a recommended retry pattern for the API now, given the changes from last month? Just want our integration to be resilient going forward.

subject: Seats went live same day - thank you
body: New seats were provisioned the same day I asked, first time that's happened. Appreciate whatever changed on your side.

subject: Export column order - already sorted
body: The column order question from a couple weeks back turned out to be a one-off, all fine since. Thanks for looking into it.

subject: Dashboards running well lately
body: No complaints here - dashboards have been fast and reliable for weeks now. Nice change from earlier in the year.

subject: Connector question - adding a second data source
body: Looking to add a second ERP connector alongside our existing one. Can you send over what's needed to get that set up?

subject: Export template for the new data source
body: Following on from the new connector, would like an export template that combines both data sources into one file. No rush, whenever it fits your schedule.

subject: Dashboard for the combined data
body: Once the export template's in place, could we get a dashboard view that shows both sources side by side? Team's looking forward to having everything in one place.

subject: Year-end report builder question
body: Building our year-end report and want to confirm the best way to reference both connectors in one formula. Things have been steady enough that I'm actually looking forward to this one going smoothly.

subject: API rate limit clarification
body: We're building an internal finance dashboard that pulls from your reporting API every 15 minutes across roughly 40 report endpoints. Before we scale this up further, could you confirm the current rate limit per API key and whether burst requests are throttled per minute or per hour? Want to make sure our integration doesn't get flagged as abusive traffic once we add the remaining regional entities next month.

subject: Threshold alerts firing at wrong values
body: Since setting up the API integration we've also had a related issue with the budget variance alert - it's meant to fire when a cost centre exceeds 5% variance, but it's triggering at roughly 2%, flooding half the finance team's inboxes with false positives. We've had to mute several of these overnight just to get through email. Could you check whether the threshold logic changed recently, or if this is something on our config side?

subject: Report builder crashing on multi-entity consolidation
body: The consolidated P&L report we build monthly across our six entities has started timing out in the report builder whenever we add more than four entity filters at once - it worked fine through September. We've had to split it into three separate reports and stitch them together in Excel before circulating to the board, which defeats half the point of having this built centrally. This is taking real time out of month-end close and needs a proper look, not a workaround on our end.

subject: Dashboard load times since the consolidation issue
body: Following on from the report builder ticket a couple of weeks ago - we're now also seeing the finance dashboards themselves taking 20-30 seconds to load for the same six-entity view, where they used to load in a few seconds. A couple of the team have started pulling numbers into Excel directly rather than waiting on the dashboard during close week, which isn't ideal given what we pay for the platform. Could someone check whether this is linked to the same underlying issue?

subject: Connector sync delays - flagging for the record
body: It's been a few months since the dashboard and report builder issues from last autumn, and while those specific bugs seem to have quieted down, the underlying connector sync between our ERP and the platform is still running six to eight hours behind during month-end, same as it was in October. We've restructured our close process around a manual export into Excel at the point we actually need the numbers, so this isn't blocking us day to day. Raising it mainly so it's on record rather than expecting an urgent fix at this stage.

subject: Seat role reset to default again
body: My seat role got reset to viewer overnight for the second time this quarter. Had to ask a colleague to bump me back up just to keep working.

subject: Alert thresholds not saving
body: Set alert thresholds three times this week and they keep reverting to default overnight. Not sure what's holding onto the old config.

subject: Connector sync gaps, missing a full day
body: Noticed a full day of data missing from our warehouse connector - sync log shows it ran, but the numbers don't match. Second connector oddity this month.

subject: Export cutting off partway through
body: Large export is cutting off at exactly 10,000 rows with no warning, even though the report has more. Happening consistently now, not a one-off.

subject: Export issue still not actually fixed
body: This is the same row-cutoff problem from last week, not a new one - whatever was 'fixed' clearly wasn't. Thirteen days feels long for something this specific.

subject: Exports broken again, different report this time
body: Different report, same symptom - cuts off partway with no error. Starting to think this is systemic rather than report-specific.

subject: API returning truncated data too
body: Now the API is returning truncated result sets, same shape of bug as the export cutoffs. Would like confirmation these are actually the same root cause before I keep chasing separate tickets for what's one issue.

subject: Re: truncation bug - still happening a week later
body: Week later and still seeing truncated API responses intermittently. This has now touched exports, the API, and cost us real analyst time re-running things.

subject: Escalating - pattern of data truncation across modules
body: I want to escalate formally. Since the winter we've had recurring truncation issues across exports and API, seat resets, and alert config not saving. Individually resolved, but I need someone to look at whether there's a shared cause before it happens again.

subject: Re: escalation - API truncating again while we wait
body: Still waiting on a substantive response to the escalation, and the API truncation is back in the meantime. This is exactly the pattern I flagged in June.

subject: Re: escalation - alert config reverting, same as December
body: Alert thresholds reverted again, same issue as back in December when this all started. I'd like this treated as one investigation, not another one-off ticket.

subject: Re: escalation - seat role reset once more
body: My seat role reset to viewer again, exactly like the very first ticket in this whole saga. Eight months of the same handful of issues cycling through.

subject: Update since the escalation review
body: Wanted to note the connector sync gap that came up this week actually got a real explanation for once, not just a reset. Feels like the escalation is finally landing somewhere.

subject: Seat roles holding steady since the fix
body: Roles have held since whatever changed this week - no resets for the first time in months. Following up on a smaller seat question while things are stable: can we get a report of role changes going forward?

subject: API stable, one remaining question
body: No truncation issues since the changes went in. One remaining question - is there a way to get notified if truncation ever happens again, rather than us catching it manually?

subject: Alert config holding too
body: Same day update - alert thresholds have held for the first stretch in a long time. Good timing given the question I just sent about failure notifications.

subject: Connector running smoothly, small tweak request
body: Everything's been steady for a few weeks now. Small ask - could the sync log include a timestamp per table rather than just per run?

subject: Report builder feature question
body: Things have been calm enough that I've had time to actually explore Report Builder properly. Is there a way to save a formula as a reusable snippet across reports?

subject: Adding a second connector, first time in a while
body: Looking to add a connector for a new data source, first new setup we've done in a while rather than fixing something old. Can you send over the requirements?

subject: Re: new connector - mapping question
body: Quick follow-up on the new connector setup - how do we map two fields with the same name from different source tables?

subject: API question for the new connector's data
body: Now that the second connector is in, is there a single API endpoint that returns combined data from both, or do we need to call each separately?

subject: Connector sync frequency for the new source
body: Can we set a different sync frequency for the new connector than our original one? The new source updates less often.

subject: Report builder - combining both connectors in one report
body: Building a report that pulls from both connectors now. Formula reference across two data sources isn't behaving as I'd expect - can you point me to documentation, or is this a case for support?

subject: Minor connector lag, year-end volume
body: Noticing a bit of lag on the newer connector with year-end volume higher than usual. Not urgent, just flagging in case it needs attention before things quiet down over the holidays.

subject: Bulk role update for reorganised team
body: We've reorganised our reporting team and need about fifteen users moved to a different role at once. Is there a faster way than doing it one by one through the admin console?

subject: Export template broke after the reorg
body: Since moving the team around, one of our shared export templates is pulling from the wrong department filter. Might be linked to the role changes from last week.

subject: Connector permissions after the reorg
body: Similar to the export template issue - a couple of connectors seem to have lost their permission mapping since the team reorg. Can you check if role changes affect connector access?

subject: Seat count review ahead of renewal
body: Ahead of our renewal conversation, could you send a current breakdown of active seats versus what we're licensed for? Want to make sure we're not over- or under-provisioned.

subject: Report builder - shared template versioning
body: When two people edit the same shared report template, is there any version history, or does the latest save just overwrite silently? Had a near-miss where someone's changes were lost.

subject: Connector question - multiple environments
body: We're setting up a staging environment alongside production - can one connector feed both, or do we need a second connector licence for staging?

subject: Export destination - adding a second recipient list
body: Straightforward one - can a scheduled export go to two separate distribution lists instead of just one?

subject: Export formatting - decimal places inconsistent
body: Noticed decimal places are inconsistent across columns in one of our recurring exports, some show two, some show none. Small thing, would be good to standardise.

subject: API — response time question
body: Our integration calls to the /data endpoint are averaging about 800ms response time. Is this within the expected range, or should we be seeing faster responses? We're pulling relatively small datasets (under 5,000 rows per call). Happy to share request details if that helps benchmark.

subject: Connector setup — mapping question for nested JSON
body: We're setting up a connector for a source that returns nested JSON. The field mapper seems to only handle flat structures — is there a way to map nested fields, or do we need to flatten the data on the source side first? Our data team would prefer to handle this within the platform if possible.

subject: Export — question about character encoding
body: We're exporting data that includes Nordic characters (å, ä, ö) and some of them are appearing as garbled characters in Excel. The CSV is opening correctly in a text editor, so the file itself seems fine — it may be an encoding declaration issue. Is the export UTF-8 with BOM or without?

subject: Report builder — conditional formatting not working
body: I've set up conditional formatting rules on a report — colour coding cells based on value ranges. The rules are saved and visible in the settings, but the formatting is not being applied in either the report view or the export. I've tried removing and re-adding the rules. The feature simply isn't working. We've been waiting on a fix for a related display issue since February and I'm starting to lose confidence that the report builder is stable.

subject: Dashboard — widgets not respecting layout on print
body: When we print a dashboard (or export to PDF), the widget layout collapses — widgets stack vertically instead of maintaining the grid layout. The on-screen layout looks fine. We share printed dashboard summaries with stakeholders who don't have access to the platform, so this matters for us.

subject: Shared dashboard — viewer sees different data than owner
body: We have a shared dashboard where one of our viewers is seeing different data than the dashboard owner. Same filters, same time range. The viewer has fewer data permissions but the filters should be controlling what's visible regardless. Is there a permission-filtering interaction that could cause this? It's causing confusion and distrust in the data.

subject: Export fails every time — cannot get data out of the platform
body: Every export attempt this week has failed. The job shows as 'completed' in the log but no file is delivered. This is the second time we've had this problem this year. We have a client deliverable that relies on this data. Please escalate.

subject: Exports still broken — different user, same problem
body: Ville raised the export failure last week. I'm raising it again because I'm now experiencing the same thing from my account, so this isn't user-specific. The platform is simply not delivering export files. We cannot get data out. This needs to be fixed today.

subject: Connector sync — stopped working entirely
body: The main data connector has stopped syncing. Last successful sync was August 10. Status shows 'active' but nothing is running. We've had recurring connector issues throughout the year and this is now affecting live reporting. Open until resolved.

subject: API — error handling question
body: A practical question: does the API return structured error codes for all failure types, or do some errors just return generic 500s? We're trying to build better error handling into our integration but the error documentation is incomplete. Just need to know what to expect so we can code accordingly.

subject: Dashboard load times — still slow
body: Dashboard load times remain slow. I've raised this before. The main dashboard is taking 15–20 seconds on a regular basis. I understand this may be a known issue. Just logging it again so it stays on record.

subject: Dashboard — date range question
body: Our finance dashboards are set to show the current fiscal year (April to March). The standard date range options don't include a fiscal year preset. Is there a way to set a custom fiscal year definition, or do we need to manually select a custom date range each time? We'd like to set it once and have it apply consistently.

subject: Export to PDF — formatting issue with wide tables
body: When we export a report with many columns to PDF, the table overflows the page width and columns on the right are cut off. We have a 14-column report that we need to share with the finance team. Is there a landscape/fit-to-page option for PDF exports? I haven't been able to find one.

subject: Connector setup — connecting to on-premise data source
body: We have a financial data source running on-premise behind our firewall. The connector documentation covers cloud sources but not on-premise setups. Is there a proxy agent or tunnel option that would allow the platform to connect to an on-premise database securely?

subject: Scheduled export — adding recipient
body: We need to add a second email recipient to a scheduled export. I can see the current recipient in the settings but there's only one field. Is there a way to add multiple recipients, or would we need to set up a separate job for each recipient?

subject: API access — where are our credentials?
body: We've been told by our account manager that API access is included in our Standard plan, but I cannot find an API key or credentials section in the admin panel. I've looked under Settings, Integrations, and Admin. Where is this located? I've been waiting three days for a response from account management and have now raised it here.

subject: Report builder — cannot build report with more than 10 columns
body: I'm trying to build a financial summary report with 15 data columns. The report builder allows me to add columns up to 10, and after that the 'Add column' button becomes inactive. Is there a limit on columns? If so, this is a significant constraint for finance reporting use cases. I raised this with account management in October and never got a definitive answer.

subject: Cannot see billing history
body: I need to access billing history for our account for our year-end audit. The admin panel shows a billing section but it just says 'Contact your account manager'. We've been trying to reach our account manager for two weeks. Can support provide billing records directly, or connect me with someone who can?

subject: Report builder — 10 column limit still in place
body: I raised the 10-column limit issue in December and received a response saying it was being reviewed. It's now February and the limit is still in place. We've worked around it by splitting our financial report into two sub-reports, which is cumbersome and makes consistent formatting difficult. Has there been any progress on this?

subject: Dashboard — showing wrong fiscal year data for second month running
body: Our main finance dashboard has been showing data from the wrong fiscal period for the second consecutive month. I reported this in January and was told it was a configuration issue on our end, which we corrected. The problem has returned. We did not change anything. This is wrong and it is causing problems in our financial reporting. We have had to add a disclaimer to every dashboard we share internally saying the data needs to be verified before use. That is not acceptable for a BI platform.

subject: Connector dropped our finance data source — AGAIN
body: The finance data source connector dropped again. This is the third time in three months. Same error as before: authentication timeout. We have not changed the credentials. The connector is simply unreliable for this source. We need a proper fix, not a 'please re-authenticate' response.

subject: Dashboard fiscal year issue is back — not fixing itself
body: The fiscal year display issue is back again. Third time. I am no longer willing to accept a configuration explanation — this is a platform bug. We have done nothing differently. Every time this is 'resolved' it returns within weeks. I need a permanent fix, not a patch.

subject: Report builder — still limited to 10 columns, 5 months later
body: Five months since I first reported the 10-column limit. It is still in place. We are running two parallel sub-reports for a single financial view. This is a basic capability that the platform simply does not support at an adequate level. I would like a written commitment to either fix this or acknowledge that it will not be fixed so we can make a decision accordingly.

subject: Alert rules — stopped receiving notifications
body: Alert notifications stopped arriving again. I'll log it but I'm not expecting a quick fix. We've had too many recurring issues with this platform to be surprised. Please look into it when you can.

subject: Connector dropped again — same issue as March
body: Finance connector dropped again. Same authentication timeout. Re-authentication fixed it as usual. Just logging it. No urgency — this is apparently just how it works.

subject: Another connector drop — logging for the record
body: Connector dropped again. Fourth time since January. Fixed with re-authentication. Not going to escalate anymore — logging for the record.
